name: EH3D-MANUFACTURING-PROFILE
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.1: early code. Profiles of the capabilities of workshop and factory machinery and of the restrictions of suppliers: a Rust library and command line that read a JSON profile whose limits always carry their unit (min_/max_ plus a quantity that ends in a unit), find numbers without a unit, bad limits, conflicting tool definitions and restrictions without a source, cite a profile by the SHA-256 of its content, and compare the measurements of a design with the limits, naming the limit, its source and the remedy. It has only run on data made by its own tests; the reading of the machine files that the server and the tool manager use, and the link with the verifier, are not written.
